name: Employee Verification & Document Authentication
author: Saqib K.

sections.description:
Every experience letter and salary certificate you issue can be checked in seconds, by anyone, on your own website.

Fake and edited HR letters are more common than most organisations realise. When a bank reviews a loan, an embassy checks a visa file or a company hires someone new, they all need to know one thing: did your organisation really issue this letter? Today that usually means an email or a phone call to your HR team, and someone has to stop what they’re doing to answer it.

Employee Verification & Document Authentication takes that job off your desk. Every letter you issue carries its own verification ID and QR code. Whoever receives the letter scans the code (or types the ID) and your website answers straight away: is the letter valid, who was it issued to, and when. If you’ve revoked it or it has expired, they see that too.

Visitors don’t need an account, nothing goes through an outside service, and your employee data never leaves your WordPress site.

Why organisations choose it

  • Fewer verification calls and emails. Banks, embassies and employers check letters themselves, any time of day, without waiting on HR.
  • Fake letters don’t get through. A made-up or mistyped ID simply shows “Not found”, and a genuine letter shows your logo, the employee’s name and the issue date, so the receiver can compare.
  • You stay in control after a letter leaves the building. Revoke a letter the moment it should no longer be trusted, give it an expiry date, or reissue it. The old QR code then points to the new letter.
  • Professional letters in minutes. Ready-made templates with your logo, colours, signature, footer and reference numbers such as EXP-2026-0007.
  • Employee ID cards that verify themselves. Print a corporate photo ID card for every employee or intern, with the same QR code check as your letters.
  • Built to keep working for years. Printed QR codes and links survive every update, and your records stay safe even if the plugin is deleted, unless you choose otherwise.
  • Genuinely free. No limits on employees, letters or letter types, and nothing in the free plugin is locked or time-limited.

Who it’s for

If your organisation writes letters about its people, and people ask “is this letter real?”, this plugin is for you.

  • Companies and corporate HR teams: experience letters, salary certificates, NOCs and relieving letters that verify themselves.
  • Staffing and recruitment agencies: a verifiable letter for every placement, so the next employer can trust it on sight.
  • Banks, finance and insurance firms: salary certificates and bank account opening letters that lenders and partner institutions can confirm.
  • Hospitals, clinics and healthcare groups: staff experience letters and internship or residency completion letters.
  • Schools, colleges and universities: teacher and staff experience letters and internship certificates.
  • IT companies and software houses: letters for remote and contract staff, verifiable from anywhere in the world.
  • Manufacturing, construction and logistics: large workforces, with employee records brought in by CSV import.
  • Hotels, retail and security firms: high-turnover teams where experience letters are requested all the time.
  • NGOs, government offices and public bodies: official letters that anyone can check without contacting your office.
  • Small businesses: the same trusted, professional verification that large companies use, at no cost.

How it works

  1. Add your employees, one by one or by importing a CSV file.
  2. Issue a letter in a few clicks: experience, internship completion, salary certificate, NOC, relieving letter or any type you create.
  3. The employee prints it or saves it as a PDF. It carries a QR code, a verification ID and, if you like, a reference number.
  4. The receiver scans the code (or opens your verification page and types the ID) and sees the result instantly.
  5. Changed your mind? Revoke the letter and the verification page shows it as revoked from that moment on.

What’s included

Verification pages your visitors can trust

  • [evda_document_verification] checks a letter by its verification ID or reference number. QR codes open this page with the ID already filled in.
  • [evda_employee_verification] lets visitors confirm that someone worked for you, by employee ID, name or national ID number. You decide which search fields are allowed and which details are shown, or turn this lookup off completely.
  • A clear result: Valid, Expired, Revoked, Replaced or Not found, shown with your logo, the issue date and the expiry date.
  • Protection against abuse: a limit on lookups per visitor, exact-name search by default, and an optional second detail (date of birth, joining date or the last 4 digits of the national ID) before an employee is shown.
  • Optional short links such as /verify/ID/. Older links keep working.
  • Responsive, accessible pages. Layouts are templates you can override from your theme, and headings and button text can be changed in Settings.
  • QR codes are generated on your own server.

HR letters that look the part

  • Ready-made letter types: Experience Letter, Internship Completion Letter, Bank Account Opening Letter, Salary Certificate, Joining Letter, Promotion Letter, Warning Letter, Transfer Letter, Relieving Letter, No Objection Certificate, and a Custom Employee Letter where you type the title and body as you issue it.
  • Create your own letter types with their own template, extra fields (for example “Monthly Salary” or “Bank Name”), email text and rules. No code needed.
  • Edit templates in a visual editor with a placeholder picker, and preview any letter type with sample data before you save.
  • Your logo, header text, colours, fonts, page margins (in millimetres), signature block and footer.
  • Opening and closing lines, reference numbers and the date format, per letter type or for all letters.
  • Letters are A4 pages that print or save as PDF straight from the browser.
  • The wording of a letter is fixed when it is issued (since 1.6.0). Later changes to the employee or the template don’t change letters already issued. Branding (logo, colours, signature) follows your current settings.
  • Optionally email the employee when a letter is issued, with a button linking to the verification page.

Full control over every letter

  • Statuses: Valid, Revoked, Expired, Replaced and Suspended.
  • Revoke with a reason (shown publicly only if you choose), reactivate, or reissue with a new verification ID. The old letter’s verification page then points to the new one.
  • An optional validity period per letter type, adjustable for each letter.
  • Letters you issued before or outside the plugin can be registered with “Import Letters”, so they can be verified too.

Employee records

  • Unlimited employees, with photo, dates, status, national ID, date of birth and your own custom fields.
  • Search, filter by department and status, export to CSV and import from CSV (with a preview before existing employees are updated).
  • Deleting an employee who has letters archives them instead, so their letters stay verifiable.

Team roles, logs and backup

  • HR Manager and HR Officer roles. Administrators always have full access.
  • An activity log of admin actions and a log of public verification attempts (90 days by default). Visitor addresses are stored only as a one-way hash.
  • Download all plugin data as one file and restore it on the same or another site. Restoring never overwrites existing records.

Your data is safe

Verification links and QR codes are printed on paper and handed to banks and employers, so they have to keep working for years. The plugin is built around that promise:

  • Updates never remove or rename your data, settings, letter links or verification links.
  • Deleting the plugin keeps your data unless you first tick Delete all plugin data when the plugin is deleted (Settings > Advanced).
  • Database updates run in the admin area only. Before an update that changes documents, the plugin offers a backup download.

Free and Pro

The free plugin is complete on its own: issuing, verifying, revoking, logs, roles, privacy tools and backup are all included, with no limits on employees, letters or letter types. Letters are issued and managed one at a time.

For organisations that issue letters at scale, the optional EVDA Pro add-on adds real PDF files attached to emails, bulk issuing and bulk actions on many letters at once, background jobs, digital signatures, employee and verification-request portals, approvals, multiple companies, a REST API and more. Pro builds on the free plugin and uses the same data, so installing or removing it never moves or loses anything. The Employee Verify > Pro screen compares the two, and details are at skfreelancers.com/evda-pro.

Placeholders

These work in letter templates and email bodies. The template editor has a picker that inserts them for you.

{employee_name} `{employee_id}` `{father_name}` `{cnic}` `{position}` `{department}` `{company}` `{joining_date}` `{leaving_date}` `{intern_start}` `{intern_end}` `{issue_date}` `{verification_id}` `{reference_no}` `{date_of_birth}` `{verify_url}` `{letter_type}` `{tasks_section}` `{custom_fields}`

Each extra field of a letter type also becomes a placeholder: a field with the key salary gives {salary}.

Privacy

The plugin stores the employee data that site administrators enter. It does not include tracking or analytics and does not contact any outside service. The public lookup forms keep a short-lived, hashed counter per visitor address (about 10 minutes) to limit repeated lookups; the address itself is not stored.

The plugin works with the WordPress privacy tools: Tools > Export Personal Data includes an employee’s record and letters (matched by email address), and Tools > Erase Personal Data either keeps the record and reports it (the default, so letters stay verifiable) or anonymises it. Both choices are under Settings > Advanced, together with how many days public verification attempts are kept (up to 90). Suggested privacy policy text is added under Settings > Privacy in WordPress.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external service. QR codes are generated on your own server (since 1.5.0). The Pro screen links to the developer’s website, but nothing is loaded from it.

License

This plugin is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the Free Software Foundation, either version 2 of the License, or any later version.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Employee Verification & Document Authentication”, then click Install Now and Activate. (You can also upload the ZIP file under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.)
  2. Open Employee Verify. A short checklist on the dashboard walks you through the first steps:
    • Create the verification pages. One click creates a “Document Verification” and an “Employee Verification” page with the right shortcodes and selects them in Settings. You can also make the pages yourself with [evda_document_verification] and [evda_employee_verification] and select them under Settings > General.
    • Upload your logo under Settings > General.
    • Add your first employee under Employees.
    • Issue your first letter from the letter buttons next to the employee. The checklist also links to a preview with sample data.
  3. Adjust the wording, styling and page margins under Settings > Letters, and the public lookup under Settings > Verification.

The checklist can be dismissed at any time. The database tables are created when you activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I issue an employee ID card?

Click Generate in the ID Card column on the Employees screen. The card gets its own verification ID and QR code and is emailed to the employee when they have an email address. View / Print opens both sides of the card, sized like a bank card (54 × 85.6 mm), ready to print on an A4 or US Letter sheet and cut out, or on a card printer. Choose the heading, colours, the details printed on each side, the text on the back and how long cards are valid under Settings > ID Cards. A lost card is replaced with Reissue: the old card then shows as replaced when it is scanned.

What does someone see when they scan an ID card?

Your verification page, with the card holder’s name, position, department, the card’s issue and expiry dates, its status (valid, expired, revoked or replaced) and, unless you switch it off, the photo on the card so they can compare it with the person in front of them.

Is my data safe when I update the plugin?

Yes. Updates only add things: new columns, tables and settings. They never remove or rename your employees, letters, settings, letter links or verification links, and printed QR codes keep working. New features start switched off on existing sites, or keep the behaviour you had, until you change them. If an update needs to change existing documents, the plugin asks you first and offers a backup download.

Should I back up before updating?

It is always a good idea. Go to Employee Verify > Settings > Tools and click Download backup to get all plugin data in one file. You can restore it from the same screen; restoring adds missing records and never overwrites existing ones. A full site backup from your host is also recommended.

Where did the Tools screen go?

In 1.8.0 it became the Tools tab of the Settings screen. Old bookmarks to the Tools screen open the new tab.

What happens to my data if I deactivate or delete the plugin?

Deactivating keeps everything. Deleting the plugin also keeps everything by default: your employees, letters and settings stay in the database, so printed verification IDs and QR codes work again as soon as you reinstall. Data is only removed if you tick Delete all plugin data when the plugin is deleted under Settings > Advanced, save, and then delete the plugin.

If I change a template, do letters I already issued change?

No, not for letters issued with 1.6.0 or later: their wording is fixed when they are issued. Branding such as the logo, colours, fonts, margins and signature does follow your current settings. Letters issued before 1.6.0 are still built from the current template; use Freeze content on the Documents screen to fix their wording.

Can I see a letter before I issue it?

Yes. On Settings > Letters, click Preview next to any template, or in the letter type editor. The preview fills the template with sample data and uses your current, even unsaved, settings. Nothing is saved or issued.

Do I need Composer or any extra libraries?

No. Letters are HTML pages sized for A4 paper. To get a PDF, open the letter and use the browser’s print dialog (Ctrl+P, then Save as PDF).

How do I add a new letter type?

Go to Employee Verify > Settings > Letters, scroll to Other Letter Types and click Add New Letter Type. Enter a name, the template and any extra fields. Once saved, it shows up in the Other Letters menu on the Employees page.

How secure are the verification IDs?

Each ID is 16 uppercase hex characters created with PHP’s random_bytes(), so they can’t realistically be guessed. Letter links carry a signed token, admin actions are protected by nonces and capability checks, and database queries with user input use $wpdb->prepare().

Can people search my employee list?

Only if you allow it. Under Settings > Verification you choose which search fields are allowed, whether names must match exactly, how many lookups a visitor may make, which details are shown, and whether a second detail is required. You can also switch the employee lookup off and keep only document verification.

Can I import employees in bulk?

Yes. Choose a file and click Import CSV on the Employees page. Click Sample file next to it for the right column names; an exported file can be imported again as it is. employee_id is required, and full_name is required for new employees. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. By default, employees whose ID already exists are skipped. Choose Update existing employees to change them instead: you see how many will change before anything is saved, and empty cells never erase existing details.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. EVDA Pro is an optional add-on for organisations that issue letters at scale. It adds to the free plugin rather than replacing it, uses the same data, and can be removed without losing anything. Nothing in the free plugin is locked or time-limited. See Employee Verify > Pro for the comparison, or visit skfreelancers.com/evda-pro. The menu disappears when Pro is installed.

Will I see adverts in my dashboard?

Only one small notice, on the plugin’s own dashboard, after you have issued 10 letters. Dismiss it once and it does not come back.

Why don’t emails arrive?

The plugin sends email through wp_mail(), like the rest of WordPress. If emails don’t arrive, install an SMTP plugin. Employee Verify > Email Log lists recent send attempts (the last 500).
sections.changelog:
1.9.3 (November 27, 2026)

  • Changed: Admin screens now use the full width of the browser window instead of stopping at 1200px. Forms and notes inside them keep their own comfortable reading widths.
  • Readme: changelog entries now show the date of each build (added where the date is known).
  • New: On the Plugins screen, a “Go Pro” link next to Deactivate opens the Pro add-on page (hidden while the Pro add-on is active), and five stars after “View details” open the WordPress.org review form.
  • Changed: The Pro page link now goes to https://skfreelancers.com/evda-pro/.
  • Developer: filter evda_review_url (address the stars open).
  • Readme: tags updated to ones the WordPress.org directory lists (qr code, document verification, certificate verification, employee, hr).
  • No database or settings change. Letters, letter links, QR codes and verification pages are unchanged.

1.9.2 (November 24, 2026)

  • Developer: filter evda_letter_design (lay a letter out in another design; receives every part of the letter) and action evda_letter_settings (fields at the top of Settings > Letters). The Pro add-on 2.6.0 uses them for four more letter designs.
  • No visible change without the Pro add-on: letters, letter links and verification pages are unchanged. No database change.

1.9.1 (November 24, 2026)

  • Developer: hooks for add-on ID card designs: filters evda_id_card_design (draw the card in another design and size) and evda_id_card_toolbar (extra controls on the card page), action evda_id_card_settings (fields in Settings > ID Cards), and EVDA_ID_Card::context() (everything a card prints). The Pro add-on 2.5.0 uses them for four more card designs.
  • No visible change without the Pro add-on: ID cards, letters and verification pages are unchanged. No database change.

1.9.0 (November 24, 2026)

  • New: Employee ID cards. A new “ID Card” column on the Employees screen (after Status) issues a corporate photo ID card for an employee or intern: organisation logo and name, photo, name, position, Employee ID, chosen details, “valid until” date and a QR code on the front; details, terms, return address and signature on the back.
  • New: The card’s QR code works exactly like a letter’s: it opens your verification page, which shows whether the card is valid, expired, revoked or replaced, and (switchable) the photo on the card.
  • New: Cards print from the browser at the exact card size (54 × 85.6 mm): both sides on an A4 or US Letter sheet with cutting lines, or one side per page for a card printer.
  • New: The employee is emailed when a card is issued, with a link to view and print it (own subject and text under Settings > ID Cards). New placeholder {document_url} for every email template.
  • New: Settings > ID Cards: card heading, colours, details on each side (including custom employee fields such as a blood group), text on the back, return address, signature, validity, reference numbers (for example ID-2026-0001) and a sample preview.
  • New: One current card per employee; “Reissue” replaces a lost card and the old card shows as replaced. Cards can be revoked, reactivated, given a new expiry date and emailed again from the Documents screen, like letters. The card’s content is fixed when it is issued.
  • Fixed: The very first save of custom employee fields under Settings > Advanced stored an empty list.
  • Developer: document type evda_id_card (class EVDA_ID_Card), filters evda_id_card_content, evda_id_card_html and evda_id_card_cell_actions. evda_issue_document( $employee_id, 'evda_id_card' ) issues a card.
  • No database change. Letters, letter links, QR codes, verification pages and emails are unchanged.

1.8.6 (November 19, 2026)

  • Changed: Bulk actions are now part of the Pro add-on. The free plugin issues, revokes, freezes and emails letters one at a time, from the letter buttons on the Employees screen and the row actions on the Documents screen. With the Pro add-on, the Employees screen has the “Issue letter” bulk action and the Documents screen has Revoke, Freeze content, Email again and Export to CSV for many letters at once.
  • New: “Email again” row action on the Documents screen, so a letter can be emailed to the employee again without bulk actions.
  • Developer: new filters evda_employee_bulk_actions and evda_document_bulk_actions, and actions evda_employees_bulk_bar, evda_employees_list_after, evda_documents_tablenav and evda_documents_screen_load, so add-ons can add bulk actions to both lists. The checkbox columns appear only when an add-on adds an action. evda_bulk_issue_limit() and its filter stay.
  • No database or settings change. Letters, links, QR codes, verification pages and emails are unchanged.

1.8.5 (November 19, 2026)

  • Tools: restore also accepts compressed backup files (.json.gz), such as the automatic backups made by the Pro add-on. Existing .json backups restore as before.
  • Tools: backups no longer include the Pro add-on’s licence key or signing certificate. Everything else is unchanged and older backups still restore.
  • Developer: EVDA_Backup::write( $handle ) writes the backup file to any stream (used by the Pro add-on’s scheduled backups). New filters evda_backup_skip_options (settings left out of backups), evda_backup_sections (add-ons add their own data to the backup file), evda_backup_restore_section and evda_backup_restore_message (add-ons restore their data), and action evda_tools_after. Unknown parts of a backup file are ignored when no add-on handles them.
  • No visible change without an add-on, no database change.

1.8.4

  • Developer: department limits. New functions evda_user_departments(), evda_user_can_department() and filter evda_user_departments. When an add-on limits a user to some departments, the employee and document lists, their department filters and the dashboard counts show only those departments for that user. The Pro add-on uses this for department permissions. Without an add-on nothing changes.
  • Developer: EVDA_Employee::get_all(), count(), get_departments() and EVDA_Document::query_list() accept departments (a list) and scope (false = ignore the current user’s limit).

1.8.3

The Pro add-on uses this for several company profiles. Without an add-on, the site’s settings are used exactly as before.
  • Developer: filters evda_reference_pattern and evda_reference_counter_key for reference numbers (for example a separate numbering per company). EVDA_Email::get_headers() accepts an optional context.
  • Nothing changes for existing letters, emails or verification pages.

1.8.2

  • Developer: add-ons can register their own document statuses (filter evda_document_statuses) and choose the status a new letter starts with (filter evda_new_document_status). The Pro add-on uses this for letters that wait for a manager’s approval. Built-in statuses cannot be changed, and only “Valid” letters ever verify as valid.
  • A letter in such an add-on status is not emailed, shows “not valid yet” on its letter link and verification page, and when it reissues another letter, the older letter stays valid until the new one is approved.
  • Nothing changes for letters with the plugin’s own statuses: emails, letter pages and verification results are exactly as before.

1.8.1

  • Developer: new filter evda_letter_signature_html to replace the signature block of a letter, and new action evda_document_result_actions inside the result buttons of the document verification page. They are used by the Pro add-on (several signatories, PDF download button). Nothing changes on sites that do not use them.
  • Note for theme overrides: if you copied verification-document.php into your theme, add the evda_document_result_actions line from the plugin’s copy to show add-on buttons there.

1.8.0 (November 18, 2026)

  • New: Visual template editor (the WordPress editor) for letter templates, with a placeholder picker. Templates you save with the new editor use paragraph formatting; templates you have not re-saved print exactly as before.
  • New: Preview any letter type with sample data, including unsaved changes, from Settings > Letters and from the letter type editor.
  • New: Page margins in millimetres for letters (Settings > Letters > Layout). Left empty, letters keep their current layout.
  • New: Settings reorganised into tabs: General, Verification, Letters, Email, Advanced and Tools. Every setting keeps its value. Fields are saved through the WordPress Settings API and checked one by one; an invalid reference number pattern is rejected with a message and the previous pattern is kept.
  • New: First-run checklist on the dashboard: create the two verification pages with one click, upload a logo, add an employee, issue a letter. It can be dismissed.
  • New: “Pro” screen comparing the free plugin with the planned Pro add-on, and one dismissible notice after 10 issued letters. Both are hidden when Pro is installed.
  • Changed: The Tools screen (backup and restore) is now the Tools tab of Settings. Old links redirect.
  • Changed: Text pasted into multi-line settings is saved with plain line breaks.
  • Fixed: The developer function evda_issue_document() no longer creates a letter when the employee ID is empty or unknown; it returns an error instead.
  • Docs: readme rewritten around employment verification and HR letters; new screenshots; FAQ on data safety, updating and Pro; corrected the email log size (500 entries) and setting locations.
  • Developer: Add-on settings tabs (evda_settings_tabs) now register their options in the group evda_settings_{slug} and print fields on evda_settings_tab_{slug}. evda_settings_saved receives the tab slug. New filter evda_pro_url and constant EVDA_PRO_URL.
  • No database changes.

1.7.0 (November 18, 2026)

  • New: Translation ready. Every text in the admin screens, letters, emails, public pages and JavaScript can be translated; a .pot file is included in /languages. Letters use the site language (lang) and right-to-left direction where needed.
  • New: “Date format on letters” setting (Settings > Letter Templates). Existing sites keep the current English format until you choose another; new installs use the site’s date format and language.
  • New: Opening line and closing line per letter type. They default to the current “To Whom It May Concern,” and “Sincerely,”, so letters look the same. When a template already starts with “Dear …” or ends with “Yours sincerely”, the settings show a one-click fix for the duplicated line.
  • New: Reference numbers per letter type (for example {TYPE}-{YYYY}-{SEQ:4} gives EXP-2026-0001), printed on new letters and available as {reference_no}. Letters issued earlier keep only their verification ID.
  • New: Optional second detail for public lookups: date of birth (new employee field), joining date or the last 4 digits of the national ID. It is needed to find an employee and to check a letter by its reference number. Verification IDs and QR codes never need it.
  • New: The “CNIC” label can be renamed (for example “National ID” or “Emirates ID”).
  • New: Redesigned, responsive and accessible verification pages with a status banner, company logo, and issue and expiry dates. Templates can be overridden from the theme. New shortcode attributes show_form and fields. Headings and button texts can be changed. The stylesheet now loads only on pages that show a shortcode, and uses evda- class names (the old ev- classes stay on the elements, so existing custom CSS keeps working).
  • New: Optional short verification links /verify/ID/ (off by default). All older links keep working.
  • New: Privacy tools: personal data exporter and eraser, suggested privacy policy text, and a retention setting for the public verification log.
  • New: Bulk issue: issue one letter type to up to 25 selected employees at once, with shared fields, a preview, optional emails and a result report.
  • Fixed: The “Remove” button for the signature image did nothing.
  • Developer: New filters evda_document_result_fields, evda_template_path, evda_format_date, evda_pretty_url_base, evda_reference_type_code.
  • Database: adds an optional date_of_birth column to employees and an evda_counters table. This runs automatically; nothing existing is changed.

1.6.0 (November 17, 2026)

  • New: Letters issued from now on keep the wording they had when they were issued. Changing an employee’s details or a template no longer changes letters already issued. Each fixed letter carries an integrity check. Letters issued before 1.6.0 look exactly as before.
  • New: “Freeze content” (row and bulk action) fixes the current wording of a letter issued before 1.6.0.
  • New: Document statuses (Valid, Revoked, Expired, Replaced, Suspended). Revoking asks for a reason; the reason is shown publicly only if you switch that on in Settings > General.
  • New: Reactivate a revoked letter, and Reissue a letter: a new letter with a new verification ID replaces the old one, whose verification page then points to the new one. The “one per employee” rule ignores revoked and replaced letters, so a letter no longer has to be deleted before issuing again.
  • New: Validity period per letter type. Letters can show “Valid until” and become Expired automatically.
  • New: Unfreeze content for fixed letters (with a warning), and “Restore fixed wording” to bring back the exact earlier text. Every change is in the Activity Log.
  • New: “Valid until” field when issuing a letter (pre-filled from the letter type, can be changed or cleared), “Set expiry” for letters already issued, and an optional valid_until column for imports.
  • New: Documents screen with search (verification ID, reference or name), filters (type, status, department, issue dates), sorting, pagination, row actions and bulk actions (revoke, freeze, email again, export to CSV), plus a details page with each letter’s history.
  • New: Dashboard shows issued this month, verifications this month and letters expiring in 30 days.
  • New: HR Manager and HR Officer roles and capabilities. Administrators keep full access.
  • New: Activity Log (admin actions) and public verification log, kept 90 days by default. Timelines on each document and employee.
  • New: Tools screen to download a backup of all plugin data and restore it. Restoring adds records and never overwrites existing ones.
  • New: Deleting an employee who has letters archives them instead (hidden from the list and the public lookup; letters stay verifiable). Archived employees can be restored or, after typing their Employee ID, deleted permanently.
  • New: Changing an Employee ID keeps that employee’s letters linked.
  • New: Developer hooks and functions for add-ons: evda_loaded, evda_document_issued, evda_document_status_changed, evda_document_verified, evda_employee_saved, evda_employee_archived, evda_letter_html, evda_letter_placeholders, evda_verification_result_fields, evda_email_args, evda_admin_menu, evda_settings_tabs, evda_document_row_actions, evda_bulk_issue_limit, evda_log_retention_days, evda_capabilities; evda_get_document(), evda_issue_document(), evda_revoke_document().
  • Improvement: Database updates now run as numbered migrations in the admin area only, never during a visitor’s page view. Before the update that touches documents, the plugin offers a backup download.
  • Improvement: The employee list loads all letters for a page in one query.
  • Fixed: If the chosen verification page is deleted, verification links fall back to the built-in address instead of breaking.

1.5.1

short_description: Issue HR letters with a QR code that banks, embassies and employers scan to confirm they're genuine on your own website. Fewer verification calls.
description:
Every experience letter and salary certificate you issue can be checked in seconds, by anyone, on your own website.

Fake and edited HR letters are more common than most organisations realise. When a bank reviews a loan, an embassy checks a visa file or a company hires someone new, they all need to know one thing: did your organisation really issue this letter? Today that usually means an email or a phone call to your HR team, and someone has to stop what they’re doing to answer it.

Employee Verification & Document Authentication takes that job off your desk. Every letter you issue carries its own verification ID and QR code. Whoever receives the letter scans the code (or types the ID) and your website answers straight away: is the letter valid, who was it issued to, and when. If you’ve revoked it or it has expired, they see that too.

Visitors don’t need an account, nothing goes through an outside service, and your employee data never leaves your WordPress site.

Why organisations choose it

  • Fewer verification calls and emails. Banks, embassies and employers check letters themselves, any time of day, without waiting on HR.
  • Fake letters don’t get through. A made-up or mistyped ID simply shows “Not found”, and a genuine letter shows your logo, the employee’s name and the issue date, so the receiver can compare.
  • You stay in control after a letter leaves the building. Revoke a letter the moment it should no longer be trusted, give it an expiry date, or reissue it. The old QR code then points to the new letter.
  • Professional letters in minutes. Ready-made templates with your logo, colours, signature, footer and reference numbers such as EXP-2026-0007.
  • Employee ID cards that verify themselves. Print a corporate photo ID card for every employee or intern, with the same QR code check as your letters.
  • Built to keep working for years. Printed QR codes and links survive every update, and your records stay safe even if the plugin is deleted, unless you choose otherwise.
  • Genuinely free. No limits on employees, letters or letter types, and nothing in the free plugin is locked or time-limited.

Who it’s for

If your organisation writes letters about its people, and people ask “is this letter real?”, this plugin is for you.

  • Companies and corporate HR teams: experience letters, salary certificates, NOCs and relieving letters that verify themselves.
  • Staffing and recruitment agencies: a verifiable letter for every placement, so the next employer can trust it on sight.
  • Banks, finance and insurance firms: salary certificates and bank account opening letters that lenders and partner institutions can confirm.
  • Hospitals, clinics and healthcare groups: staff experience letters and internship or residency completion letters.
  • Schools, colleges and universities: teacher and staff experience letters and internship certificates.
  • IT companies and software houses: letters for remote and contract staff, verifiable from anywhere in the world.
  • Manufacturing, construction and logistics: large workforces, with employee records brought in by CSV import.
  • Hotels, retail and security firms: high-turnover teams where experience letters are requested all the time.
  • NGOs, government offices and public bodies: official letters that anyone can check without contacting your office.
  • Small businesses: the same trusted, professional verification that large companies use, at no cost.

How it works

  1. Add your employees, one by one or by importing a CSV file.
  2. Issue a letter in a few clicks: experience, internship completion, salary certificate, NOC, relieving letter or any type you create.
  3. The employee prints it or saves it as a PDF. It carries a QR code, a verification ID and, if you like, a reference number.
  4. The receiver scans the code (or opens your verification page and types the ID) and sees the result instantly.
  5. Changed your mind? Revoke the letter and the verification page shows it as revoked from that moment on.

What’s included

Verification pages your visitors can trust

  • [evda_document_verification] checks a letter by its verification ID or reference number. QR codes open this page with the ID already filled in.
  • [evda_employee_verification] lets visitors confirm that someone worked for you, by employee ID, name or national ID number. You decide which search fields are allowed and which details are shown, or turn this lookup off completely.
  • A clear result: Valid, Expired, Revoked, Replaced or Not found, shown with your logo, the issue date and the expiry date.
  • Protection against abuse: a limit on lookups per visitor, exact-name search by default, and an optional second detail (date of birth, joining date or the last 4 digits of the national ID) before an employee is shown.
  • Optional short links such as /verify/ID/. Older links keep working.
  • Responsive, accessible pages. Layouts are templates you can override from your theme, and headings and button text can be changed in Settings.
  • QR codes are generated on your own server.

HR letters that look the part

  • Ready-made letter types: Experience Letter, Internship Completion Letter, Bank Account Opening Letter, Salary Certificate, Joining Letter, Promotion Letter, Warning Letter, Transfer Letter, Relieving Letter, No Objection Certificate, and a Custom Employee Letter where you type the title and body as you issue it.
  • Create your own letter types with their own template, extra fields (for example “Monthly Salary” or “Bank Name”), email text and rules. No code needed.
  • Edit templates in a visual editor with a placeholder picker, and preview any letter type with sample data before you save.
  • Your logo, header text, colours, fonts, page margins (in millimetres), signature block and footer.
  • Opening and closing lines, reference numbers and the date format, per letter type or for all letters.
  • Letters are A4 pages that print or save as PDF straight from the browser.
  • The wording of a letter is fixed when it is issued (since 1.6.0). Later changes to the employee or the template don’t change letters already issued. Branding (logo, colours, signature) follows your current settings.
  • Optionally email the employee when a letter is issued, with a button linking to the verification page.

Full control over every letter

  • Statuses: Valid, Revoked, Expired, Replaced and Suspended.
  • Revoke with a reason (shown publicly only if you choose), reactivate, or reissue with a new verification ID. The old letter’s verification page then points to the new one.
  • An optional validity period per letter type, adjustable for each letter.
  • Letters you issued before or outside the plugin can be registered with “Import Letters”, so they can be verified too.

Employee records

  • Unlimited employees, with photo, dates, status, national ID, date of birth and your own custom fields.
  • Search, filter by department and status, export to CSV and import from CSV (with a preview before existing employees are updated).
  • Deleting an employee who has letters archives them instead, so their letters stay verifiable.

Team roles, logs and backup

  • HR Manager and HR Officer roles. Administrators always have full access.
  • An activity log of admin actions and a log of public verification attempts (90 days by default). Visitor addresses are stored only as a one-way hash.
  • Download all plugin data as one file and restore it on the same or another site. Restoring never overwrites existing records.

Your data is safe

Verification links and QR codes are printed on paper and handed to banks and employers, so they have to keep working for years. The plugin is built around that promise:

  • Updates never remove or rename your data, settings, letter links or verification links.
  • Deleting the plugin keeps your data unless you first tick Delete all plugin data when the plugin is deleted (Settings > Advanced).
  • Database updates run in the admin area only. Before an update that changes documents, the plugin offers a backup download.

Free and Pro

The free plugin is complete on its own: issuing, verifying, revoking, logs, roles, privacy tools and backup are all included, with no limits on employees, letters or letter types. Letters are issued and managed one at a time.

For organisations that issue letters at scale, the optional EVDA Pro add-on adds real PDF files attached to emails, bulk issuing and bulk actions on many letters at once, background jobs, digital signatures, employee and verification-request portals, approvals, multiple companies, a REST API and more. Pro builds on the free plugin and uses the same data, so installing or removing it never moves or loses anything. The Employee Verify > Pro screen compares the two, and details are at skfreelancers.com/evda-pro.

Placeholders

These work in letter templates and email bodies. The template editor has a picker that inserts them for you.

{employee_name} `{employee_id}` `{father_name}` `{cnic}` `{position}` `{department}` `{company}` `{joining_date}` `{leaving_date}` `{intern_start}` `{intern_end}` `{issue_date}` `{verification_id}` `{reference_no}` `{date_of_birth}` `{verify_url}` `{letter_type}` `{tasks_section}` `{custom_fields}`

Each extra field of a letter type also becomes a placeholder: a field with the key salary gives {salary}.

Privacy

The plugin stores the employee data that site administrators enter. It does not include tracking or analytics and does not contact any outside service. The public lookup forms keep a short-lived, hashed counter per visitor address (about 10 minutes) to limit repeated lookups; the address itself is not stored.

The plugin works with the WordPress privacy tools: Tools > Export Personal Data includes an employee’s record and letters (matched by email address), and Tools > Erase Personal Data either keeps the record and reports it (the default, so letters stay verifiable) or anonymises it. Both choices are under Settings > Advanced, together with how many days public verification attempts are kept (up to 90). Suggested privacy policy text is added under Settings > Privacy in WordPress.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external service. QR codes are generated on your own server (since 1.5.0). The Pro screen links to the developer’s website, but nothing is loaded from it.
